cases.observed_error: error in environment variable `CARGO_PROFILE_RELEASE`: could not load config key `profile.release` / Caused by: invalid type: Option value, expected a boolean or string
cases.cause: cargo-bloat 0.12.1 derives CARGO_PROFILE_<NAME>_STRIP from the profile name (src/main.rs:690-696); a profile literally named `release-lto` collides with Cargo's own `profile.release.lto` key
the analyzer unconditionally pushes CARGO_PROFILE_<PROFILE>_STRIP=false because it needs symbols (src/main.rs:694-696)

limitations: The measured file is an ANALYSIS build: the analyzer forces strip off, so the binary is not byte-identical to what a project asking for stripping would ship. Recorded in the DTO as analysis_build_symbols_forced.
A stripped report is unreachable through this analyzer at all.
`--profile` is unusable with Cargo 1.98.1; LTO is expressed through a product-owned environment variable instead.
Only ELF64/AArch64 is exercised. Mach-O and PE are not qualified; WASM is unsupported by the analyzer.
Exit codes other than 0 and 1 remain uncalibrated.
